title: AES in ECB mode is selected
remediation: Use authenticated encryption such as AES-GCM with correctly managed keys and nonces.
scope: Recognized framework Cipher.getInstance with a literal or file-constant transformation: AES/ECB, or bare AES whose provider default is ECB. Variables, providers and runtime use remain unverified.

title: A weak digest primitive is used; review its security purpose
remediation: Replace collision-sensitive uses of MD5 or SHA-1; a digest API alone does not prove a security-sensitive use.
scope: Recognized MessageDigest literal selection or CommonCrypto MD5/SHA1 call; no security-purpose or exploitability proof. Swift files importing CryptoKit also report Insecure.MD5 and Insecure.SHA1.

title: Platform-controlled data reaches an Android raw SQL statement
remediation: Keep the SQL statement constant and pass untrusted values as bound parameters.
scope: Function-scoped known platform-input flow to SQLiteDatabase rawQuery/execSQL first argument; no method dispatch, arbitrary-parameter taint, helper sanitization or exploit proof. 1.5 adds SQLiteQueryBuilder.query and the groupBy, having, orderBy and limit arguments of query, types locals built with an imported class's constructor, and reads nested provider classes (Outer$Inner).

title: Platform-controlled input reaches a WebView without a recognized local validation guard
remediation: Parse the input and enforce an HTTPS scheme and an exact host allowlist before loading it. Avoid passing platform-controlled strings to JavaScript evaluation; use structured arguments.
scope: Function-scoped local def-use; runtime reachability and authentication are unverified.

title: Partial string allowlist guards a WebView load
remediation: Validate a parsed URI's scheme and complete hostname. A subdomain suffix must include the leading dot; review redirects and subsequent navigation separately.
scope: Function-scoped local def-use; runtime reachability and authentication are unverified.

title: SSL error callback proceeds with a rejected certificate
remediation: Cancel the SSL error. Fix the server certificate or the application's trust configuration.
scope: Function-scoped local def-use; runtime reachability and authentication are unverified.

title: A native JavaScript interface is present while platform-controlled content is loaded
remediation: Remove native interfaces before loading untrusted content, restrict origins, and expose only the minimum necessary functionality. Validate redirects and subframes on the test build.
scope: Function-scoped local def-use; runtime reachability and authentication are unverified.

title: WebView TLS error bypass
remediation: Cancel TLS errors. Validate the server certificate through the platform trust implementation.
scope: Actual DEX calls and same-basic-block constants; no runtime exploitability proof.

title: WebView file-origin access enabled
remediation: Disable file-origin cross-origin access; use WebViewAssetLoader for local content.
scope: Actual DEX calls and same-basic-block constants; no runtime exploitability proof.

title: JavaScript-to-native bridge requires origin review
remediation: Review loaded origins and exposed methods. Verify that untrusted content cannot invoke privileged native operations.
scope: Actual DEX calls and same-basic-block constants; no runtime exploitability proof.

title: WebView debugging explicitly enabled
remediation: Disable WebView debugging in release builds.
scope: Actual DEX calls and same-basic-block constants; no runtime exploitability proof.

title: Potential credential in ordinary preferences
remediation: Review the data sensitivity and use platform-backed secure storage where required. Verify logout invalidation and deletion policy.
scope: Actual DEX calls and same-basic-block constants; no runtime exploitability proof.

title: Potential sensitive data in logs
remediation: Remove or redact sensitive values and verify with a unique test canary in a release-equivalent test build.
scope: Actual DEX calls and same-basic-block constants; no runtime exploitability proof.

title: Position-independent executable flag absent
remediation: Review build/linker hardening for this executable.
scope: Embedded executable metadata; signature authenticity is not verified.

title: Debug task entitlement present
remediation: Remove get-task-allow from the distribution build.
scope: Embedded XML entitlement observation; candidate when DER entitlements are also present; signature authenticity is not verified.

title: Debuggable app configuration
scope: See per-report coverage and assertion evidence.

title: Cleartext traffic configuration
scope: See per-report coverage and assertion evidence.

title: App Transport Security exceptions
scope: See per-report coverage and assertion evidence.

title: Canary persistence after an asserted state transition
scope: See per-report coverage and assertion evidence.

title: Canary exposed in app-scoped UI
scope: See per-report coverage and assertion evidence.

title: Protected deep-link canary exposed after logout
scope: See per-report coverage and assertion evidence.

title: Declared Objective-C navigation input reaches WKWebView
scope: CST and declared header/type identity, function-local straight-line flow only. Preprocessing, dispatch, swizzling, interprocedural flow, security purpose and runtime reachability remain unverified.
remediation: Validate navigation trust and redirects; review security use of MD5/SHA-1.

title: Objective-C calls a weak digest primitive
scope: CST and declared header/type identity, function-local straight-line flow only. Preprocessing, dispatch, swizzling, interprocedural flow, security purpose and runtime reachability remain unverified.
remediation: Validate navigation trust and redirects; review security use of MD5/SHA-1.

title: Exported component without a permission
scope: Source and AAB manifests; launcher activities and permission-protected components excluded; no reachability analysis.

title: Application backup explicitly allowed
scope: Explicit allowBackup=true in source and AAB manifests; backup rule files are not evaluated.

title: targetSdk below the current Google Play requirement
scope: Declared targetSdk compared with API 36 (Play requirement from 2026-08-31); lower levels raise severity.

title: Required-reason API used without a privacy manifest declaration
scope: Swift/Objective-C symbol names for Apple's five required-reason categories against NSPrivacyAccessedAPITypes in .xcprivacy files in the tree.

title: Hard-coded credential in a known format
scope: Private keys and AWS, GitHub, Slack, Stripe live, OpenAI, Anthropic and Google API key formats; values are masked in evidence.

title: Mutable PendingIntent wraps an Intent without a recognized explicit component
scope: PendingIntent factory call whose flags, written only with framework flag names and integer literals, include FLAG_MUTABLE, or omit FLAG_IMMUTABLE (mutable by default on Android 11 and lower; not reported when the manifest declares minSdk 31+), wrapping an Intent with no class, component or package where it is built in the same function. Project constants and conditional flags are not followed, and default mutability is not reported for an Intent built elsewhere.

title: ATS exception domain weakens transport security
scope: NSExceptionDomains entries that allow HTTP, lower the minimum TLS version below 1.2 or disable forward secrecy, and NSAllowsArbitraryLoadsForMedia, in source Info.plist files.

title: Server trust accepted without evaluation
scope: Swift functions that complete an authentication challenge with URLCredential(trust:) and .useCredential without calling SecTrustEvaluate or SecTrustEvaluateWithError in the same function.

title: Non-cryptographic random value assigned to a security-named variable
scope: Case-sensitive single-statement check: java.util.Random, kotlin.random.Random, ThreadLocalRandom or Math.random assigned to a variable whose camelCase or snake_case words include token, nonce, salt, otp, secret, password, passcode, iv or session id. Swift and Objective-C files report rand, random, drand48, lrand48, mrand48 and GameplayKit random sources the same way; arc4random and the Swift default generator are secure.

title: A broken cipher algorithm is selected
remediation: Use AES-GCM or ChaCha20-Poly1305 with keys from the Android Keystore.
scope: Framework Cipher.getInstance with a literal or file-constant DES, DESede/3DES, RC4/ARCFOUR, RC2 or Blowfish transformation.

title: Cryptographic key material comes from a constant in the app
remediation: Generate keys in the Android Keystore or the iOS Keychain or Secure Enclave, or fetch per-user keys from a server.
scope: SecretKeySpec, DESKeySpec, DESedeKeySpec, PBEKeySpec, CryptoKit SymmetricKey(data:) and P256/P384/P521/Curve25519 private keys, and SecKeyCreateWithData for private keys, when the material is a literal, a literal array, a BuildConfig field, an immutable constant of the same file, or a byte conversion or decoder of those. A value passed to any other call first is treated as filled at runtime.

title: A constant IV or nonce is used for encryption
remediation: Generate a new random IV or nonce for every encryption and store it with the ciphertext.
scope: IvParameterSpec, GCMParameterSpec and CryptoKit AES.GCM/ChaChaPoly nonces built from constant or zero-filled material that no call has filled in the same function.

title: An Intent taken from another Intent's extras is launched
remediation: Do not launch Intents received from other apps; allowlist the nested Intent's component and package and drop URI grant flags if forwarding is required.
scope: getParcelableExtra/getParcelable (including IntentCompat and Kotlin generic forms) on the component's Intent or its extras, passed to startActivity, startService, bindService or sendBroadcast in the same function without a component or package check.

title: An implicit Intent with an app-defined action is sent
remediation: Make internal Intents explicit and protect broadcasts with a signature permission.
scope: An Intent built in the same function with a literal or file-constant action outside the android.* namespaces and no class, component or package, passed to startActivity, startService, bindService or sendBroadcast without a receiver permission. LocalBroadcastManager is excluded.

title: An externally controlled name reaches a file path
remediation: Reduce untrusted names to a basename or generate file names, and check the canonical path stays inside the intended directory.
scope: Intent data and extras, exported-provider arguments, content provider display names, archive entry names and URL query items reaching File, FileOutputStream/FileInputStream, FileWriter/FileReader, RandomAccessFile, openFileOutput/openFileInput, URL.appendingPathComponent, appending(path:) or URL(fileURLWithPath:) in the same function. File(x).name, lastPathComponent and substringAfterLast("/") reduce input to a file name; a canonical-path prefix check or a '..' check anywhere in the function suppresses the result.

title: Biometric result is not bound to a key or keychain item
scope: BiometricPrompt.authenticate without a CryptoObject (by argument count on a receiver declared as BiometricPrompt), FingerprintManager.authenticate(null, ...), and LAContext.evaluatePolicy in a file with no Keychain access control or authentication context.

title: Biometric authentication falls back to the device credential
scope: setDeviceCredentialAllowed(true), DEVICE_CREDENTIAL in setAllowedAuthenticators or setUserAuthenticationParameters, evaluatePolicy(.deviceOwnerAuthentication), and userPresence or devicePasscode access-control flags. Whether the operation is sensitive is not decided.

title: Biometric-protected key survives new biometric enrollment
scope: setInvalidatedByBiometricEnrollment(false), and biometryAny or touchIDAny access-control flags.

title: WKWebView file URLs may read other local files
scope: allowFileAccessFromFileURLs or allowUniversalAccessFromFileURLs enabled by key-value coding, and loadFileURL read access to Documents, Library, Caches, temporary or home directories, resolved through assignments in the same file.

title: Network security configuration trusts user-installed CAs
scope: The network security configuration referenced by the manifest: user certificates in base-config or domain-config trust anchors; debug-overrides are excluded. Cleartext permitted there is reported as ANDROID-CLEARTEXT.

title: Web link intent filter is not verified as an App Link
scope: VIEW and BROWSABLE intent filters with an http or https host and no android:autoVerify="true". assetlinks.json and the device's verification state are not checked.
